description: The pie chart represents the distribution of different types of errors made by the Audio-Reasoner. There are a total of six slices, each representing a different type of error. The largest slice, representing 37% of the errors, is for Perceptual Error. The second largest slice, representing 20% of the errors, is for Reasoning Error. The third largest slice, representing 15% of the errors, is for Correct Answer but Wrong Choice. The fourth largest slice, representing 12% of the errors, is for Repeat Thinking and No Answer. The fifth largest slice, representing 9% of the errors, is for Lack of Knowledge. The smallest slice, representing 4% of the errors, is for Choice Format Error. The chart does not include a legend, and the percentages are labeled inside the slices. The slices are not visually emphasized in any particular way.
